test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question: Which of these statements is NOT true?

options.text: The narrator first contemplated going back to the road.
The stranger was in a hurry to leave the building.
The narrator was seeking food and shelter.
The stranger leaving the house was its owner.

solution:
The correct answer is '**The stranger leaving the house was its owner.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage makes no explicit mention that the man leaving the house is its owner.
 
• The narrator describes the stranger as hurriedly leaving the house and does not assume ownership.
 
• The behavior of the stranger, who leaves the door open and is busy with his watch, does not imply ownership.
 
• The narrator is also puzzled by the stranger's actions but does not identify him as the owner.
 
• The narrative focuses on the stranger's hurried departure and peculiar behavior rather than any indication of him owning the house.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The narrator first contemplated going back to the road: This is true as the narrator reconsidered and thought about returning to the road.
 
• The stranger was in a hurry to leave the building: This is true; the stranger is described as being hurried and busy.
 
• The narrator was seeking food and shelter: This is true; the narrator seeks comfort, warmth, and the inviting smell of food.
